Maya L: Morning all — quick poll: who’s bringing holiday cookies tomorrow at the office? Also low-key desk-shelfie contest: bring one tiny item to your desk and we'll do a photo chain at 11:30. Sign up below! @here :cookie:
Alex J: I can bring ginger snaps :raised_hands: Any allergy notes?
Priya S: Nut-free household here, please label anything w/ nuts. Also I vote for a tiny snowman as the desk winner :snowman_with_snow:
Devon R: Vegan chocolate chip incoming :tada: I'll put them on the 'kitchen table' with a little note.
Maya L: Amazing, thanks! Quick sign-up (copy+paste to add yourself):
```
1. Alex J - ginger snaps
2. Devon R - vegan chocolate chip
3. Maya L - sugar cookies (gf batch)
```
Samira K: tiny decor = my inflatable snowman. It's 10cm of chaos. Prepare yourselves :snowman:
Eli M: I have glowsticks leftover from last year — perfect for tiny wreaths. Batteries? I have AAAs.
Alex J: lol @Samira K I demand photo proof
Samira K: upload: https://photos.company/samira-inflatable.jpg (tiny but dramatic)
Ops-Bot: Reminder: office kitchen closes at 6pm today for cleaning. :warning:
Priya S: Can we do a quick 11:30 photo chain? Everyone posts a 3-second clip or a shelfie thread, then we'll pick a 'most festive' for the Slack header :sparkles:
Maya L: 11:30 works. I'll start the chain with my mini wreath (glowstick included) :sparkles:
Alex J: pumped. also if anyone wants to drop cookies by my desk before 11 I'm happy to taste-test :eyes:
Eli M: I'll bring extra batteries and a spare box of tea :tea:
Maya L: Perfect. See you all tomorrow! :heart:
